local_context.value: 19.0% of Bluffton residents were 65 or older at the 2020 census (7.3% in 2010); population grew from 27,716 (2020) to an estimated 36,807 (2025). Humid subtropical climate, about 50.4 inches of rain a year; hurricanes are a summer and early-fall threat. Old Town is a historic district on the May River bluff (Bluffton Historic District, National Register), with homes from the 1800s.

neighborhoods.value: Old Town, Palmetto Bluff, Jones Estate, Buckwalter, Shultz Tract (the Town's five primary areas); Sun City (planned community nearby)

place_entities.value: Church of the Cross (1857); Bluffton Historic District; Sun City Hilton Head; Heyward House Historical Center (named in Wikipedia Bluffton article)

permit_office.value: Town of Bluffton, Growth Management department, Building Safety (residential and commercial building permit applications; Town phone 843-706-4500). The page does not state the issuing office in a sentence; this follows its placement under Building Safety.
